product_facts: Holds a chosen temperature between 50°C and 65°C for up to 3 hours on battery
Keeps drinks warm for up to 6 hours with the battery off (insulation only)
Leak-proof lid that opens with one hand
Charges on its coaster; a full charge takes about 2 hours
Companion app shows drink temperature and battery level
Lid is dishwasher-safe; mug body is hand-wash only
brand.claims_policy: Only state facts from the list above. No health or medical claims, no comparisons naming other brands, and no absolute words like 'never', 'forever' or '100%'.
brand_dos: Use concrete numbers and everyday moments (commute times, meetings, school runs)
Speak to one person, in second person ('you', 'your')
Keep sentences short; one idea per sentence
brand_donts: Make fun of the reader or their situation
example_lines: Three meetings later, still the right sip.
Pour at 8. Sip at 10. Same coffee.
brand.product_description: Brewly Smart Travel Mug. Your coffee, on your schedule. Holds a chosen temperature between 50°C and 65°C for up to 3 hours on battery.
key_benefits: Holds a chosen temperature between 50°C and 65°C for up to 3 hours on battery
Leak-proof lid that opens with one hand
